package.name: robocup_realtime_monitoring
package.description: RoboCup realtime monitoring tools. - Strategy GUI: edit BT zone policies (dribble/kick/pass) on the court + live robot/ball overlay - UDP sender: bridge ROS2 robot state topics to MessageV2 UDP broadcast (robocup_udp_sender) The strategy GUI receives robot positions via UDP (UdpTeamListener) without any external sender dependency.
